findings.claim: KLA 10-K FY2026 risk factor：公司稱無法預測 AI 發展的步調，AI 驅動的顛覆可能以難以預測的方式影響半導體供應鏈；競爭對手可能在 AI 策略上更成功。未點名具體替代技術。
findings.excerpt: We cannot predict the pace or trajectory of AI development or the extent to which AI-driven disruption will affect the semiconductor industry, and AI technologies may disrupt the broader semiconductor supply chain and ecosystem in ways that are difficult to predict.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子列「可能無法跟上產業技術變化」，為公司自述的技術風險之一。
findings.excerpt: We may not be able to keep pace with trends and technological changes in the industries in which we operate;

findings.claim: Yole 2026 檢測計量報告：先進邏輯、DRAM、HBM、EUV 與先進封裝使製程控制強度持續上升，另有多技術檢測與混合計量興起（摘要引述）。
findings.excerpt: As advanced logic, DRAM, HBM, EUV lithography, and advanced packaging evolve, process-control intensity continues to rise

findings.claim: Nearfield Instruments（新進計量廠商）與 imec 於 2025-11 啟動多年合作，涵蓋 High-NA EUV 光阻計量與混合鍵合特徵化，QUADRA 部署於 imec Leuven。
findings.excerpt: Nearfield Instruments will deploy its flagship system, QUADRA, at Imec's advanced R&D facility in Leuven.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未找到點名 e-beam 或 AI 計量為 KLA 替代品的來源；as_of 為估計日期。
